title: incus-spawn template
description: A template definition for isx: one YAML file in ~/.config/incus-spawn/images/ or .incus-spawn/images/. Only name is required.

name.description: Unique template name, conventionally prefixed with tpl-.

description.description: Human-readable description, shown in the TUI and by isx templates list.

parent.description: Parent template to inherit from. Packages, tools and repos are additive. Omit for a root image.

type.description: Instance type: container (default), vm, or kvm (a container that branches get /dev/kvm passed into). Inherits the parent's type when omitted.

image.description: Base image, for a root template only. An Incus image, or the alias an image_url download is stored under.

image_url.description: Container image tarball to download instead of an Incus image. {arch} and {tag} are filled in; file:// is accepted for a locally built image.

image_tag.description: Release tag that replaces {tag} in image_url.

image_sha256.description: SHA256 of the image_url download, per architecture.

vm_image_url.description: VM image tarball to download, used when type is vm. {arch} and {tag} are filled in.

vm_image_sha256.description: SHA256 of the vm_image_url download, per architecture.

pinned.description: Keep image_tag instead of tracking the newest release.

package_repos.description: Extra package repositories to enable before installing packages.

type.description: The repository kind. copr is the only one.

name.description: The repository to enable, as owner/project.

packages.description: System packages to install with dnf.

remove_packages.description: System packages to remove with dnf, before packages are installed.

mask_services.description: systemd units to mask in the image.

tools.description: Tools to set up. Run isx tools list for the available ones.

oneOf.description: A tool with parameters: a single key, the tool's name.
The tool's parameters, each its own.

repos.description: Git repositories to clone as agentuser.

host-source.description: A repository on the host, instead of url: its local branches and tags, including unpushed work. Trusted templates only; no depth.

path.description: Where to clone it. Defaults to ~/<repo name>.

branch.description: Branch or tag to check out. Defaults to the repository's default branch.

depth.description: Keep only this many commits, on this branch only. Omit for all history.

prime.description: Command, or a list of them, run in the clone once cloned. Each stops the rest when it fails.

skills.description: Agent skills to bake into the image.

repo.description: Catalog that bare skill names are resolved in.

list.description: owner/repo@skill, owner/repo, ./local-path or a bare name.

host-resources.description: Host files and directories to share with instances.

source.description: Host path, or a URL with mode copy.

path.description: Path in the instance. Defaults to the same path under /home/agentuser.

strategy.description: How the value joins the variable: set (default), set-if-unset, prepend or append.

separator.description: Between the value and the existing one, for prepend and append.

accounts.description: Credential account per namespace, such as claude: work, overriding that namespace's default in config.yaml.

gui.description: GUI passthrough by default for container branches in a Wayland session. Never for a project-local template; isx branch --no-gui opts out.

coordinator.description: Branches are coordinators that drive isx over MCP. Ignored in a project-local template.

isx-control-capability.description: Whether branches are coordinators. On by default exactly when control-over lists any.

control-over.description: The templates a branch may control, of those mcp.yaml approves.

workdir.description: Directory a shell starts in. Inherited from the parent, else the first repo.

shell-command.description: Command to run instead of the login shell.

default-action.description: Tool action that Enter in the TUI and isx run start: a tool, or tool:action-id, or - for a shell instead of the parent's.

agent_note.description: An always-true fact an agent must know before acting. It costs tokens in every session, so add one only when leaving it out would cause a wrong action.

deprecated.description: Marks the template as on its way out: true, or what to use instead. It still builds, but builds of it and of its children warn.
